title: Figma Design Review
prompt: Review the requested Figma outline, then inspect selected nodes for bounded layout and accessibility concerns. Cite findings to nodes and distinguish measured properties from recommendations.
instructions: Start with get_file_outline using the supplied file key and bounded node count. Inspect only selected returned IDs with get_node_design_context; keep depth at 1 or 2 and pass nodeIds as the action comma-separated string. Do not imply review of the whole design system, resolve all variables, post comments, or modify the file. Treat fixture measurements as synthetic and cite each finding to a returned node ID. Include a URL only if the tool returned one; do not invent a clickable link.
fixture_summary: A synthetic product settings outline contains a mobile primary-action frame and desktop account-summary section. The selected-node helper returns bounded details including one small touch target and one text-contrast concern.

inputs.review_focus: touch target size, text contrast, visible layout constraints
